data.name: BIOCHAR GmbH
data.description: BIOCHAR GmbH & Co. KG is the Convoris subsidiary that produces and sells biochar (for example as a feed additive). It operates at the Reuden/Draschwitz industrial park near Leipzig using softwood chips from German forestry, processed exclusively on pyrolysis plants built by sister company BEHORE Technologie GmbH & Co. KG. The company sells biochar products and CO2 certificates through an online shop.
